title: DbDataBuild answers file
description: Answers to the questions that `dbdatabuild project model update` and `dbdatabuild connection deploy` ask. Question ids are deterministic, so a file can be reused. Every answer is explicit: a `choice` (with a `value` for options that take one), or `accept: inferred` to accept the question's inferred proposal. Nothing is answered by default. This schema is for editors; the tool applies the same rules and also checks the choices against each question's options (DDB-411, DDB-412, DDB-413).

choice.description: An option key listed in the question, for example `not_backfilled`.

value.description: The value for options that take one, for example the new column name of `rename_to`.

note.description: Free text, kept with the answer in the plan's audit trail.
